citation: Schalk G, McFarland DJ, Hinterberger T, Birbaumer N, Wolpaw JR. BCI2000: a general-purpose brain-computer interface (BCI) system. IEEE Trans Biomed Eng 2004;51(6):1034-1043. EEG Motor Movement/Imagery Database, PhysioNet (Goldberger et al. 2000).
record_used: subject S002, baseline run R02 (eyes-closed), channel POz (posterior), first 10 s at 160 Hz (1600 samples) -- the SAME git-tracked vector the signal-moments, Jarque-Bera, SVD-entropy and Katz cases use.
pipeline: readRDS(eeg_poz_s002r02) -> PhysioAnalysis::medianAbsDev: the median absolute deviation MAD = constant * median(|x - median(x)|), constant=1 (raw). The reference re-computes it with BOTH scipy.stats.median_abs_deviation and base R stats::mad(constant=1), via reticulate, and also computes the normal-consistent robust SD estimate (x 1/qnorm(0.75)) and the population SD. Deterministic.
note: medianAbsDev is a NEW robust-dispersion op, the robust companion of signalMoments' classical SD; the ecosystem had no median-based robust scale. With the default constant=1 (the raw MAD) it reproduces BOTH scipy.stats.median_abs_deviation (scale=1) AND base R mad(constant=1) BIT-FOR-BIT (max |diff| 0 vs each) -- a double-reference agreement, because the raw MAD is an unambiguous order statistic. CONVENTION note: the normal-consistent constant is 1/qnorm(0.75) ~ 1.4826; base R mad() defaults to a rounded 1.4826 while scipy scale='normal' uses the full-precision value, so the two differ at ~1e-6 in the scaled form -- this case validates the RAW MAD (exact across tools) and reports the normal-consistent value using the full-precision constant. Finding: the normal-consistent MAD-scale (48.93) matches the population SD (48.83) to within 0.2% (ratio 1.002); because MAD is robust and SD is not, this agreement is positive evidence that the eyes-closed POz amplitude distribution is near-Gaussian and free of heavy-tailed artifacts -- cross-consistent with the signalMoments (skew -0.23, excess kurtosis +0.16) and Jarque-Bera folds on the same channel. A robust/classical divergence (MAD-scale below SD) would instead flag artifact contamination.
